hero.name: Trần Công Tính
bio_paragraphs: I am a Software Developer dedicated to engineering resilient backend systems and scalable microservices architectures.

Specializing in the Java/Spring Boot and Node.js/Express ecosystems, I design distributed APIs, implement event-driven architectures with RabbitMQ/Kafka, and build AI-enhanced & blockchain-integrated platforms.
I thrive in collaborative agile environments, bringing a complex problem-solving mindset and a commitment to continuous learning to every phase of the software development lifecycle.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
about.bio: I'm a passionate backend developer focused on building robust, scalable systems. With hands-on experience in microservices, blockchain integration, and AI-powered features, I bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and practical applications.

items.title: SmartRental — AI & Blockchain Rental Platform
description: Designed a modular backend architecture of 6 business modules. Implemented 20 REST controllers, 33 services, and 160+ RESTful APIs with Spring Boot & PostgreSQL + PgVector.
Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using LangChain4j and Gemini API for context-aware chatbot.
Deployed 595-line Solidity smart contracts on Ethereum Sepolia for immutable lease agreements with EIP-712 signatures.
Implemented role-based access control using JWT authentication and Spring Security.

items.title: Household Appliance E-Commerce Platform
description: Architected 9 microservices (7 business, API Gateway, Eureka) — each with its own MongoDB database.
Configured Spring Cloud Gateway with Resilience4j Circuit Breaker and custom JWT filters for fault-tolerant routing.
Implemented inter-service communication using OpenFeign (sync) and RabbitMQ (async), alongside Global Exception Handling.
Integrated SEPay QR code payment with real-time WebSocket (STOMP) status updates.
Containerized the complete microservices environment running 11 service containers using Docker Compose.

items.title: Zala — Real-time Messaging Platform
description: Built Node.js/Express/TypeScript backend with 10 controllers and 22 service modules.
Implemented real-time messaging supporting chat, group management, presence tracking, and live streaming using Socket.IO.
Integrated Redis for session/caching and Apache Kafka for event streaming.
Implemented peer-to-peer video calling via WebRTC + LiveKit and dual AI chatbot system (Gemini & Groq).
Managed 6 services using Docker Compose + Jenkins CI/CD and deployed on DigitalOcean.
Developed cross-platform mobile application using React Native + Expo with AWS S3 storage.
